messages:
sam.support: Hi team — customer (LargeFinCorp) opened an ISO27k evidence request. They want: mapping of audit logs to Annex A controls, sample log exports (redacted), KMS/HSM key custody evidence, and repro steps for the 401 + intermittent latency they saw last week. Can we confirm scope and what we can hand over?

maria.legal: Thanks Sam. We need to confirm the scope (production only? retention windows?), and whether we can provide key metadata without revealing key material. Also need to check NDAs before sharing any customer-identifying logs.

ajay.eng: For repro we should capture a minimal curl that reproduces the 401 and a short latency trace. Is the root cause suspected auth token expiry or gateway throttling? Sam, can you paste the minimal repro and an example log snippet (redact tokens)?

sam.support: Repro steps I used locally (prod-ish env):
```
# reproduce 401 from token exchange path
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-4x","input":"test"}'
# reproduce latency spike: fire 20 concurrent requests with sequence length ~2048
```
And an anonymized log lines we pulled: 
```
2026-03-10T11:22:33Z ERROR auth exchange_failed user_id=redacted client_id=lfc-123 http_status=401 err="invalid_grant"
2026-03-10T11:22:33Z WARN gateway request_queue_time_ms=1200 route=/v1/generate model=rwd-4x
2026-03-10T11:22:34Z INFO runtime batch_size=12 tokens=2048 tail_latency_ms=620
```
Note: billing alert also fired around 11:24 (invoice processing returned 402 for a short window) — might be unrelated but customer mentioned billing break earlier.

liam.sre: For KMS/HSM evidence: we can provide key metadata (key id, creation date, rotation policy, KMS ARN), rotation logs (audit trail entries showing rotate events), and HSM attestation report from vendor. We cannot share private key material. We should also include access control lists showing which service principals can call kms:Decrypt.

maria.legal: Confirmed. Also we need to map these to ISO controls:
- A.9 (access control) -> IAM policies + ACL exports
- A.12.4 (logging and monitoring) -> log retention and integrity checks
- A.10.1 (cryptographic controls) -> KMS/HSM specs + rotation evidence
We should propose a log sampling plan rather than full exports.

ajay.eng: Proposal for sampling: 7 days of full structured logs (redacted) for the incident window, plus 90-day aggregated metrics (latency p50/p95/p99, auth error rates). Provide a CSV of the metrics and a gzipped JSONL of redacted logs limited to request_id, timestamp, route, http_status, model, error_code, latency_ms.

compliance-bot: Checklist generated: [x] NDA check, [ ] PII redaction, [ ] Key material withheld, [ ] Signed data sharing addendum, [ ] Export signed by security owner.

maria.legal: PII redaction: remove user_id and any prompt content. Replace with placeholders (user_id=<redacted>, prompt_hash=<sha256>). Also we need to timestamp the package and include a chain-of-custody note (who exported, when, where).

sam.support: I'll prepare the sample bundle and an accompanying readme for the customer with repro steps, the metric CSV, and the redaction summary. ETA EOD tomorrow. Any objections?

liam.sre: One more ask — include a short note about our KMS key separation: customer data keys are envelope-encrypted with per-customer DEKs; only master keys are in HSM. Add the KMS policy snippet for clarity.

ajay.eng: Sending a minimal policy example we can include:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd-ef01","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:CallerAccount":"redwood-prod"}}}
  ]
}
```

maria.legal: Good. Also include our retention matrix (90d hot logs, 365d cold archive, 7y compliance export) and cite the policy doc id: POL-RET-001.

sam.support: Noted. I'll scope for prod-only incident window, sample export + metrics, KMS metadata + rotation logs, attestation PDF attached. I'll ping when bundle ready. :thumbsup:
